tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground in the app and on the website. Everything else sits on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, tables, cards, inputs, menus, modals. The default reading surface.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table headers, code wells, segmented-control tracks, inactive tabs.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows, menu items and ghost buttons.

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: The selected row, tree node or nav item. Pair with text-selected.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: panel edges, table rules, dividers. Decorative, not for controls.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes and secondary buttons: 3.3:1 on surface light, 3.5:1 dark.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on bg, surface and surface-sunken (14.5:1 or better both themes).

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Body copy in long passages and secondary labels on surface and bg (9:1 or better).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata, timestamps, helper text, placeholders on surface, bg and surface-sunken (5:1 or better).

tokens.name: text-selected
tokens.usage: Text on surface-selected.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one action colour: primary buttons, selected tab underline, active nav. One primary button per view.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of primary fills.

tokens.name: text-on-primary
tokens.usage: Label on a primary fill: 6.3:1 light, 7.2:1 dark. Dark theme uses dark text on the lighter blue.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links and ref links on surface and bg (5.9:1 light, 8.3:1 dark). Underline on hover.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus outline with 2px offset on every focusable element: 4.3:1 on bg light, 7:1 dark.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Pass, completed, approved. Teal, not green, so it stays distinct from danger for colour-blind readers. Text on success-bg (5:1 light, 6.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Pass chips and success callouts.

tokens.name: success-border
tokens.usage: Edge of success chips and callouts.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Blocked, in review, suspect link, attention needed. Text on warning-bg (5.2:1 light, 6.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Warning chips and callouts.

tokens.name: warning-border
tokens.usage: Edge of warning chips and callouts.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Fail, aborted, error, destructive action text. Vermilion, not red. Text on danger-bg (4.9:1 light, 6:1 dark).

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Fail chips, error callouts, destructive-confirm dialogs.

tokens.name: danger-border
tokens.usage: Edge of danger chips and callouts; invalid input border is danger itself.

tokens.name: agent
tokens.usage: Anything an AI agent did or proposes, and nothing else. Text on agent-bg (6.1:1 light, 6.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: agent-bg
tokens.usage: Agent proposal panels and agent chips.

tokens.name: agent-border
tokens.usage: Edge of agent panels and chips.

tokens.name: info-bg
tokens.usage: Neutral information callouts; text is link-coloured primary or text.

tokens.name: neutral-chip
tokens.usage: Draft, not run, unknown: the chip fill. Text on it is text-secondary.

tokens.name: brand-blue
tokens.usage: The ring-and-check blue of the logo. Marks, illustrations and the cover only; UI uses primary.

tokens.name: brand-slate
tokens.usage: The wordmark slate of the logo. Marks only.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind modals, drawers and bottom sheets.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Website hero headline only. Max two lines.

styles.name: display-sm
styles.usage: Website section headlines; hero on phones.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: Website sub-headline and section intros. Max 65 characters a line.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Artifact title in the document pane; page titles on settings pages.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Panel and section headings inside the app.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default app text: forms, buttons, document body.

styles.name: body-dense
styles.usage: Tables, trees, lists, notes. The workhorse size.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, button labels, tab labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata, timestamps, helper text, chip text.

styles.name: ref
styles.usage: Stable refs (REQ-12, TC-4, HDG-2) everywhere they appear.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline code, logs, IDs, cron expressions.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; table cell vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell horizontal padding; input padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding; phone side gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between panels; dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page padding in the app; card padding on the website.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections in the app; website gutter on tablets.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Website gutter on desktop; hero columns gap.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Website section padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Website section padding on desktop. Hero top padding maximum.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, ref badges, tiny tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: The default: buttons, inputs, panels, cards, table containers.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Overlays only: modals, popovers, bottom sheets, screenshot frames on the website.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status chips and avatars only.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Optional lift on a panel that floats over bg. Prefer a border.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, tooltips.

tokens.name: shadow-modal
tokens.usage: Modals, sheets, and the product screenshot in the website hero.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Compact buttons and inputs in toolbars.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default button and input height on desktop.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area on touch screens and the phone layout.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: Tree and table row height in the app.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: App navigation sidebar.

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: App top bar and website nav.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Longest line of running text, app and website.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Website content column; app settings and document pages.
